{{Quote|Well, it's not much to look at, but there it is&mdash;Kinooine."<br />"But... it's so... barren!|Luke Skywalker and Dani|<ref name="marvel95" />}}
'''Kinooine''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. Kinooine served as the main staging point for the [[Nagai–Tof War]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. A world devoid of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] life before the Nagai's arrival, Kinooine became the site of [[Skirmish on Kinooine|two duels]] between the "[[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]]" [[Lumiya]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who was unable to prevent the Nagai from seizing the planet. After the ultimate Nagai defeat, Kinooine became home to a population of refugee [[Firrerreo/Legends|Firrerreo]].

==Description==
{{Quote|There's plenty of shelter, in case of a storm, or an attack... not that one's likely, on an empty planet. And there's plenty of fresh water for you and me to drink, Dani... and for Kiro to replenish his breathing supply... or relax in...|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="marvel95" />}}
Located in the [[Kinooine system/Legends|Kinooine system]] of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]],<ref name="TEAOC" /> Kinooine was a barren [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="marvel97" /> near the boundary with the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="nagai">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/nagai11202009/index.html|text=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs|int=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs}}</ref> Kinooine was a world of rocky caves and [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], and was almost totally devoid of life. However, the planet's craggy surface held plentiful [[Water/Legends|water]] and breathable air,<ref name="marvel95" /> and had some native plant life, including a [[Species/Legends|species]] of pink flowers.<ref name="marvel97" />

==History==
{{Quote|This will be our first stronghold, from which all our future conquests must proceed.|Dal Zorfenn|<ref name="marvel97" />}}
[[File:LandingOnKinooine.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Luke Skywalker, Dani and Kiro arrive on Kinooine.]]
A desolate, lifeless world, Kinooine suddenly rocketed to the center of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] intrigue in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], when the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] began registering mysterious life readings from the planet's surface. The Alliance dispatched a team of 20 [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] to Kinooine to investigate&mdash;there, they stumbled upon the forerunners of a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Nagai–Tof War|invasion]]. The scout team was ambushed by [[Lumiya]], the "[[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]]," and her [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Den Siva]],<ref name="marvel95" /> who had been sent to secure Kinooine as a staging point for a [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] military force<ref name="marvel97" /> from the nearby [[Firefist]] dwarf galaxy.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Lumiya and Siva [[Death/Legends|killed]] 19 of the 20 Alliance scouts,<ref name="marvel95" /> allowing the sole survivor, [[Faron Tolis]], to survive in exchange for his service.<ref name="marvel96">[[Star Wars (1977) 96|''Star Wars'' (1977) 96]]</ref>

Tolis' [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], soon followed with a small team to investigate the scouts' disappearance, but he and his friends&mdash;Alliance agents [[Dani/Legends|Dani]] and [[Kiro]]&mdash;were ambushed by Lumiya and Siva as well, with Dani kidnapped and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] and Skywalker bested in a [[Skirmish on Kinooine|duel]]. Kiro freed Skywalker from captivity, and Skywalker emerged from Lumiya's underground base to defeat the "Dark Lady" in a rematch. Skywalker's victory coincided with the arrival of the larger [[Nagai expeditionary force]] to Kinooine, accompanied by a force of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|troops]].<ref name="marvel96" /> The Nagai fleet, commanded by [[Dal Zorfenn]], quickly moved to secure the planet, which served as the jumping-off point for a wider war on the Alliance. Hopelessly outnumbered, Skywalker and Dani were forced to flee Kinooine empty-handed, and with the planet firmly in Nagai control.<ref name="marvel97" />

The Nagai invasion of the galaxy was ultimately unsuccessful, and their fleet mostly returned home afterward.<ref name="nagai" />Following the toppling of the [[Empire Reborn]]<ref name="TNEGTOAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]],<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a remnant of the [[Firrerreo/Legends|Firrerreo]] people&mdash;a [[Near-Human]] race that was subjected to a genocide by the Empire<ref name="tcs">''[[The Crystal Star]]''</ref>&mdash;settled on Kinooine. Unlike their fellow remnant on [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]], they survived the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TNEGTOAS" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|Be sure that there are none besides the Nagai, and our allies and prisoners, alive anywhere on this world.|[[Cyn Jodu]]|<ref name="marvel97" />}}
Although formerly completely devoid of life, in 4 ABY Kinooine overnight became home to a sizable Nagai invasion force, mostly centered out of a series of underground bases originally constructed by advance agents Lumiya and Den Siva. The Nagai also brought along a number of Imperial allies and prisoners to the suddenly populated Kinooine, and added a great amount of infrastructure to the once-desolate world.<ref name="marvel97" /> Although the Nagai population on Kinooine proved to be temporary,<ref name="nagai" /> Kinooine later became home to a much longer-lasting group of Firrerreo who settled on the world after the fall of the Empire Reborn.<ref name="TNEGTOAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kinooine first appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 95|''Star Wars'' (1977) 95]], written by [[Mary Jo Duffy]], illustrated by [[Cynthia Martin]] and released in [[1985]].<ref name="marvel95" />
